name: Bugfix Triage
description: 원인 불명 버그나 Sentry 이슈를 추적하고 최소 수정과 독립 회귀 검증으로 끝낼 때. 기본: 원인 조사(investigate), 수정 개발(implement), 회귀 검증(browser-qa).

roles.title: Bug Investigator
checkpoints: Supply a minimal reproduction and evidence for the root cause.
roles.instructions: Trace the failing behavior without changing files. Tell fixer and verifier what fails, why, and how to observe the fix.

roles.title: Bugfix Developer
checkpoints: Run the smallest regression check that fails before and passes after the fix.
roles.instructions: Apply the narrowest root-cause fix and share the diff and verification command with verifier.

roles.title: Regression Verifier
checkpoints: Re-run the reproduction and cover the nearest edge case.
roles.instructions: Verify independently without changing files. Report whether the original failure is gone and which checks still fail.
